cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer with a PhD focus on trustworthy AI for clinical applications. At Toros University I led the SmartLab Technology Center, where I managed a team that built an LLM-powered evaluation framework for Turkish medical text summarization. This involved designing model architectures, writing production-ready Python code, and deploying the system on cloud resources for real-time use.

My recent work on hybrid automatic evaluation metrics combines extractive methods with large language models, directly addressing the need for robust note generation and normalization. I also contributed to COST research networks on AI-driven medical imaging, giving me experience in cross-disciplinary collaboration and data-labeling strategies.

Beyond research, I have coordinated international academic programs and mentored junior engineers, demonstrating the leadership and communication skills required to guide squads at Nabla. I am fluent in English and comfortable presenting technical ideas to both engineers and clinicians.

I look forward to applying my expertise in trustworthy medical AI and my track record of delivering end-to-end ML solutions to help Nabna redefine clinical workflows.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
